levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن أسماء

notes: «أخبراه أنهما، كلما عبد الله بن عمر»: Ubayd Allah and Salim are co-transmitters, then Ibn Umar, the Companion
The second route repeats «جويرية، عن نافع», so it is a separate group with a null tail

Its chain does not close: «أن بعض بني عبد الله، قال له» puts a son of Abdullah in the scene, not as a link; the first-person «قال خرجنا مع النبي» has an unnamed speaker (rule 11), so the speaker is not written
Both routes carry the same Umra story: one saying, so no saying labels
